@gap{2 lines fragmentary} @gap{unknown no. of lines missing}

@note{cf. @xref[t.6.1.01,t.6.1.01.153]{6.1.01.153}, @xref[t.6.1.01,t.6.1.01.159]{6.1.01.159}, @xref[t.6.1.02,t.6.1.02.62]{6.1.02.62}, @xref[t.6.1.02,t.6.1.02.142]{6.1.02.142}, @xref[t.6.1.03,t.6.1.03.9]{6.1.03.9}, @xref[t.6.1.16,t.6.1.16.b4]{6.1.16.b4-5}, @xref[t.6.1.22,]{6.1.22: ll. 26-27}, @xref[t.6.1.25,t.6.1.25.7]{6.1.25.7}} A …… shepherd's sex appeal is his testicles; a gardener's is his hair. …… a waterskin. He who does not support a wife, and who does not support a son. Although the dishonest man was unable to build his own house, he came to serve as a construction worker at my friend's house. A dishonest man chases after women's genitals; an unreliable man has two sickles. A house built by a righteous man is destroyed by a treacherous man.

No one walks together with him or directs their steps towards him. Life @varh[t6123.v1]{passes him by like water } @vart[t6123.v2,]{@note{1 ms. has instead:} eludes him just as he avoids others }. He is dear to no just man, @varh[t6123.v3]{plague prevails over him } @vart[t6123.v4,]{@note{1 ms. has instead:} life is not given to him }. Like a worthless penny, @varh[t6123.v5]{……; no one …… } @vart[t6123.v6,]{@note{1 ms. has instead:} he is thrown away; no one cares about him }. He is clothed with a garment as if a heavy punishment were assigned to him. @varh[t6123.v7]{Who is he? His name? A man sleeping with someone's wife. } @vart[t6123.v8,]{@note{1 ms. has instead:} Who is he? He is a man who slept with someone's wife. }

@note{cf. @xref[t.6.1.01,t.6.1.01.128]{6.1.01.128}, @xref[t.6.1.22,]{6.1.22: ll. 146-147}, @xref[t.6.2.3,t623.h9]{6.2.3: UET 6/2 210}} In the sky there is the raven, on the earth there is the mongoose; and in the desert a lion in its den; my husband, where shall I go? @gap{unknown no. of lines missing}

@note{cf. @xref[t.6.1.19,t.6.1.19.c7]{6.1.19.c7}, @xref[t.6.1.21,t.6.1.21.c1]{6.1.21.c1}, @xref[t.6.1.24,t.6.1.24.8]{6.1.24.8}} A man's waterskin is his life. A man's sandals are his eyes. A man's wife is his ……. A man's son is his protective shade. A man's daughter is his eager servant. A man's daughter-in-law is his policeman.
